explanation:
The central tree retains the seed's major responsibilities while shrinking from 144 to 96 lines (33.3%) and from 10,752 to 7,306 characters (32.0%). Six peripheral trees expand evidence capture, experiment approval, runtime execution, materialization, assessment, and resource lifetime. Modular boundaries follow service responsibilities rather than file containment; nested calls show execution, ownership branches identify retained state and cleanup, and data dependencies identify the evidence required by downstream operations. Edges connect specific concept lines. Diagram dimensions and edge endpoints were checked; all trees use printable ASCII and occupy nonoverlapping character-grid rectangles.

Corrections and qualifications: infrastructure/mapping/evals/agentContextEvalRuntime.ts:18-20 checks that source references were already resolved; it does not itself resolve them as the seed suggests. Its finally cleanup surrounds the prompt attempt, so the peripheral scopes cleanup accordingly. application/mapping/evals/judgementService.ts:31-35 makes runId/outputKey optional, correcting the seed's unconditional linkage wording. application/mapping/evals/evalRunService.ts:654-667 retries validation failures, while runtime exceptions bypass that catch. Manual/model evaluator wording is restricted to imported comparisons; deterministic native results remain separate.

Source-backed additions include revisionBoundary and self-comparison focus defaults (compareSessionService.ts:33-41,177-193), stage-only prompt hashes and metadata-only saves (evalPromptService.ts:14,156-165), internal experiment fields and recovery after partial approval launches (experimentService.ts:8-15,120-147), review-time context/template creation (evalRunService.ts:425-449), label-based edge reanchoring (rollUpMaterializer.ts:29-48), replacement of old jump lists and root-first results (linkedCanvasesMaterializer.ts:79-89), missing-session failure handling (judgementService.ts:45-51), and late-output archival (evalRunService.ts:553).

Evidence is limited to context.json and seed.json. The few-shot counts and history sequencing are represented as declared workflow contracts and visible delegation boundaries; the helper implementations were not supplied. The legacy adapter, deterministic scoring internals, and catalog publication internals are likewise not expanded beyond supplied call sites. No external sources or layout examples were used.
